title: An Industrial Soiree

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: Well, fancy running into you here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, fancy running into you here.

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: I'd gravitate to a well-dressed--and good smelling person, no matter the locale. Seriously though, what is that delightful scent? Ammonia-Chai? Bleach Blossom?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'd gravitate to a well-dressed--and good smelling person, no matter the locale. Seriously though, what is that delightful scent? Ammonia-Chai? Bleach Blossom?

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: The one and only. Who else do you know who could keep a place like this open? This be where warriors gather.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The one and only. Who else do you know who could keep a place like this open? This be where warriors gather.

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: Well, I gotta finish this mid-shift think-tank thing. Real marketing brainsesh. 'Research'.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, I gotta finish this mid-shift think-tank thing. Real marketing brainsesh. 'Research'.

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: Dynamic ways to integrate unexpected ingredients into pure ice cocktails while maintaining a full flavor profile and not allowing any of the good stuff to freeze off.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Dynamic ways to integrate unexpected ingredients into pure ice cocktails while maintaining a full flavor profile and not allowing any of the good stuff to freeze off.

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: It's a science. Every drop of liquid has the opportunity to be part of the perfect cocktail... If you're good enough to make it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's a science. Every drop of liquid has the opportunity to be part of the perfect cocktail... If you're good enough to make it.

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: Me? I'm the cocktail connoisseur. The libatious liberator of your languishing libido. If that's your thing. And if it's not? Well there's more than one way to crest sensation.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Me? I'm the cocktail connoisseur. The libatious liberator of your languishing libido. If that's your thing. And if it's not? Well there's more than one way to crest sensation.

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: Pure passion! That's what flows in our veins. The people inside these walls come to rest, victorious, in the fight against the cresting shadows of those above.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Pure passion! That's what flows in our veins. The people inside these walls come to rest, victorious, in the fight against the cresting shadows of those above.

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: What ugh... what do you mean by that?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What ugh... what do you mean by that?

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: Haha, that little loud mouth. Ah, I don't know about him. You keep weird company.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Haha, that little loud mouth. Ah, I don't know about him. You keep weird company.

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: Wait... who are you talking about?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wait... who are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: Not important. What's important is you said you were looking for a LICCY?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not important. What's important is you said you were looking for a LICCY?

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: Well, for this to continue you should know that I only talk business at private events.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, for this to continue you should know that I only talk business at private events.

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: Weeelllllll... There's a little logistical issue with some of the catering and I can't have a party that disappoints so... leaves me kinda fucked. I mean, you get it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Weeelllllll... There's a little logistical issue with some of the catering and I can't have a party that disappoints so... leaves me kinda fucked. I mean, you get it.

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: Wait! I'll give you the LICCY. Get the catering squared away and it's yours. Deal?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wait! I'll give you the LICCY. Get the catering squared away and it's yours. Deal?

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: Finnnneeeee. Help me square it away and I'll transfer the docs. Deal?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Finnnneeeee. Help me square it away and I'll transfer the docs. Deal?

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: And you have to hire me as a cocktail consultant. At least part-time.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And you have to hire me as a cocktail consultant. At least part-time.

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: Righteous! I'll send you the caterer's location. You're the best. Oh, and if you could kinda prioritize this, the party needs to happen ASAP. Thanks!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Righteous! I'll send you the caterer's location. You're the best. Oh, and if you could kinda prioritize this, the party needs to happen ASAP. Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: Pub. Cocktail lounge. Swanky sweat-infused dance club. I'd gravitate to a well-dressed soul no matter the locale. Zig knows passion when he sees it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Pub. Cocktail lounge. Swanky sweat-infused dance club. I'd gravitate to a well-dressed soul no matter the locale. Zig knows passion when he sees it.

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: Don't got enough going on already? Still looking for a path to champagne waterfalls and glasses made from the newest neon?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Don't got enough going on already? Still looking for a path to champagne waterfalls and glasses made from the newest neon?

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: Is that... that's really what you're here to talk about? And even if it seems unreasonable or downright unbelievable, you'll need to be a lot more open minded if you're gonna drink your way to the top. You want the LICCY or no?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Is that... that's really what you're here to talk about? And even if it seems unreasonable or downright unbelievable, you'll need to be a lot more open minded if you're gonna drink your way to the top. You want the LICCY or no?

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: Who says you can't be both? Though I don't wanna be constantly beckoned, strung-out and at my wits end, trading expensive liquor for favors or cash. Nah, I'll stick to being a bartender.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Who says you can't be both? Though I don't wanna be constantly beckoned, strung-out and at my wits end, trading expensive liquor for favors or cash. Nah, I'll stick to being a bartender.

nodes.speaker: Ziggy RaSand
nodes.text: There just so happens to be a private event coming up. Maybe. We could talk business there.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There just so happens to be a private event coming up. Maybe. We could talk business there.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: At a pub?

pronounText.TextSheVersion: You're the bartender at Odin's Pub?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You're the bartender at Odin's Pub?

nodes.text: So fix me a drink then.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So fix me a drink then.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So fix me a drink then.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So fix me a drink then.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't really know you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't really know you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Warriors?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Warriors?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What are you researching?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What are you researching?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Ugh... what?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ugh... what?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And... your part is?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And... your part is?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: If you have a business to make it for.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If you have a business to make it for.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: If you have a business to make it for.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: If you have a business to make it for.

nodes.text: Heard you're looking to give up your license.

pronounText.TextSheVersion: Heard you're looking to give up your license.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Heard you're looking to give up your license.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Banor isn't weird company!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Banor isn't weird company!

nodes.text: Who do you think told me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Who do you think told me?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Who do you think told me?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Who do you think told me?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Who are YOU talking about?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Who are YOU talking about?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm interested.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm interested.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What will it cost?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What will it cost?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why "maybe?"

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why "maybe?"

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: When is it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Will you give me the LICCY if I help you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Will you give me the LICCY if I help you?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Will you give me the LICCY if I help you?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Will you give me the LICCY if I help you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not really. Good luck.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Deal.

nodes.speaker: Player

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Maybe I did.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe I did.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: ...How would you make glasses out of neon?

pronounText.TextSheVersion: ...How would you make glasses out of neon?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: ...How would you make glasses out of neon?

nodes.text: Ok.

nodes.text: Are you a bartender or a politician?
